data.title: Custom Software Engineer
data.azureopenaiSummary: The role involves designing, executing, and maintaining synthetic test scenarios for complex vehicle software and simulations. Responsibilities include analyzing requirements, developing test scenarios, defect investigation, and collaboration with global teams. Required skills include embedded product verification, analytical thinking, scenario design, and experience with relevant technical tools. A Bachelor's degree and 7+ years' experience are essential.
data.qualificationShort: Bachelors degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering Computer or Electrical Engineering Automotive Engineering or equivalent technical experience is required
data.jobDescription:
Project Role : Custom Software Engineer
Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.
Must have skills : Embedded Product Verification & Validation
Good to have skills : NA
Minimum 3 year(s) of experience is required
Educational Qualification : Bachelors degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering Computer or Electrical Engineering Automotive Engineering or equivalent technical experience is required

Summary:
The Senior Analyst will analyze requirements, develop, execute and maintain synthetic test scenarios for complex vehicle software and simulation systems. The role translates high-level behavioral requirements, hypothetical test intents and diagrams into clear, parameterized test scenarios. The Senior Analyst will independently handle assigned testing activities, analyze results, investigate defects and work with software and simulation engineering teams to resolve issues. The focus is on delivering diverse, robust scenarios that test the intended behavior while respecting physical and logical constraints, with clear documentation and handovers across US and India teams.

Roles & Responsibilities:
Plan and execute assigned scenario generation, testing and maintenance activities in line with the agreed test strategy and delivery plan.
Analyze high-level test intents, diagrams and behavioral requirements to define scenario specifications, parameters and acceptance criteria clarify gaps with the Test Lead and engineering teams.
Design diverse scenario permutations using combinatorial testing to meet coverage goals while avoiding unnecessary duplication.
Analyze interactions between software modules, state machines, environmental physics and simulator configurations to ensure scenarios test the intended system behavior.
Develop and maintain reusable configuration rules and parameter sets for reliable bulk generation and execution across automated data pipelines.
Apply scenario quality checks, boundary conditions, tolerances and metrics to distinguish genuine behavioral issues from acceptable execution variation.
Execute scenarios, analyze results and investigate failures document reproducible defects and work with software and simulation engineering teams on retesting and closure.
Update assigned scenarios as requirements, simulator configurations and testing methodologies evolve, and assess the impact on existing coverage.
Estimate effort for assigned work, track progress and provide clear handovers across US and India teams escalate dependencies and delivery blockers to the Test Lead.
Participate in peer reviews and share technical knowledge with colleagues working across simulation engineering, technical art, level design and procedural generation.
Maintain accurate records of scenario coverage, execution results, defects and maintenance needs, and communicate findings and technical risks to the Test Lead and relevant engineers.
Support evolving methods, including synthetic transformation of logged events and procedural agent injection into real-world telemetry


Professional & Technical Skills:
Work planning and ownership: Ability to estimate effort, prioritize assigned activities and deliver testing and maintenance work against agreed timelines.
Technical independence: Ability to develop and troubleshoot scenarios independently, seek clarification when needed and contribute to peer reviews and knowledge sharing.
Analytical thinking: Strong problem-solving skills to break down complex requirements, identify dependencies and make evidence-based decisions.
Clear communication: Ability to explain test findings, defects, technical constraints and risks clearly to the Test Lead and engineering stakeholders.
Global collaboration: Ability to work effectively with distributed teams, communicate dependencies and maintain clear cross-location handovers.
Quality focus: A structured approach to scenario checks, documentation, traceability and reproducible issue reporting.
Adaptability: Ability to work with different specialist skills and adjust testing approaches as methods and tools evolve
Systems architecture and modular thinking: Strong understanding of interdependent software architectures, state machines and the interactions between software modules, environmental physics and simulator configurations.
Parametric design and spatial logic: Ability to apply Boolean logic, geometric constraints and time-based conditions to dynamic 3D environments.
Synthetic scenario design: Ability to translate abstract test intents and diagrams into realistic, varied scenarios that challenge behavioral requirements without violating physical or logical constraints.
Combinatorial testing: Ability to design parameter combinations that provide broad, meaningful coverage without unnecessary overlap.
Algorithmic scalability: Ability to define reusable, programmatic rulesets and configurations that remain reliable across variable inputs and high-volume automated pipelines.
Robustness and boundary value analysis: Strong understanding of edge cases, tolerances and metrics that isolate the intended signal while allowing acceptable execution variation.
Simulation configuration: Ability to review and troubleshoot scenario configurations, system states and simulator behavior.
Tools and configuration languages: Experience with visual node-based tools such as Unreal Engine Blueprints or Unity, or configuration languages such as JSON and XML, is beneficial.
Scenario lifecycle management: Ability to maintain reusable scenario libraries and assess the impact of changes to requirements, configurations and simulation environments.
Evolving testing methods: Understanding of synthetic transformation of logged events and procedural agent injection into real-world telemetry is beneficial.

Additional Information:
- The candidate should have minimum 7 years of experience in Embedded Product Verification & Validation with 5 years of Exp in Synthetic test Generation.
- This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
- A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering Computer or Electrical Engineering Automotive Engineering (Systems and Controls), Applied Mathematics, Physics, or equivalent technical experience is required.
